description: §19.16.1 (S432 review B-1) — a match-arm PAYLOAD binder named `defer` (`.A(defer) :> { defer [1].split("").forEach(note) }`) makes `defer [` ambiguous exactly like a `let defer`: before `defer` was a statement the tokens indexed the payload (the program ran `y;a;`); read as a defer statement it throws a TypeError in the finally. E-DEFER-AMBIGUOUS-LEAD, exactly once.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S439 #6 (the four defer SPEC calls, all recs)
rationale: §19.16.1: where a binding named `defer` is visible at a `defer [`, the program is rejected naming both spellings rather than silently re-read; a match-arm payload binder is a binding visible in its arm.
